response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND o.orderbase IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS a FROM j), ch AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS ca FROM j GROUP BY orderbase) SELECT AVG(ch.ca) AS mean_channel_avg_feerate, AVG(ch.ca - overall.a) AS mean_excess_over_average FROM ch CROSS JOIN overall WHERE ch.ca > overall.a

assumptions.assumption: 'Average' is the overall mean feerate across all fee rows linked to orders (row-level, non-null feerate). A channel is above average if its own mean feerate exceeds that. Orders with a NULL orderbase are excluded.

The 'mean average fee rate' is the mean of the qualifying channels' per-channel average feerates, and the 'how far above' figure is the mean of (channel average minus overall average), with no rounding.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Average' is the mean of the per-channel average feerates (each channel weighted equally) rather than the row-level mean.
